notes.id: Tanukonomy Plus hadir: masuk akun untuk mencoba fitur Plus gratis, lalu lanjut berlangganan bulanan atau tahunan lewat Google Play.
notes.en: Tanukonomy Plus is here: sign in to try Plus features for free, then keep them with a monthly or yearly subscription through Google Play.

notes.id: Di Akun kamu bisa melihat status Plus, mengelola langganan, dan memulihkan pembelian di ponsel lain; Plus tetap aktif sesudah keluar akun.
notes.en: In Account you can see your Plus status, manage your subscription, and restore a purchase on another phone; Plus stays active after you sign out.
